answers.rationale: The WAL is append-only with record kinds Begin/Commit/Insert/Update/Delete (wal.rs:22-31). Replay reads records sequentially and stops at first invalid record (wal.rs:118-155). Recovery re-applies committed transactions and drops the uncommitted suffix — classic WAL replay. No ARIES undo, no double-write, no shadow paging.
